about: The Longbow's own sounds. The voice ("Autocraft Tank", made with Voice Design, eleven_ttv_v3) is the tank's commander: an older, weathered, laconic artillery veteran, dry and precise, raspy and the lowest of the roster, slower than the Juggernaut, on the armour intercom; its lines go through comm.py like the others'. Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>): vtank = reports in, tdeath = his cry as the tank blows up (the blast plays with it), cannon = the twin 90 mm guns in tank mode (one ripple of both per shot, every 1.04 s, heard where the tank stands), siegeshot = the anchored shock cannon (every 2.14 s, heard where the tank stands), siegehit = the shell's burst where it lands (Rules.flight after the shot: 0.37-0.76 s), siegeup / siegedown = the tank setting up and packing up (Rules.anchorTime, 2.7 s, before its first anchored shot or its first move).

entries.text: [dry, laconic] Tank's up. Give me a grid.
[weathered, precise] Big guns online. Name the hill.
[deadpan, clipped] Armor's here. Point at it.
[dry, clipped] Guns warm. Need a crater?

entries.prompt: twin tank cannons fire in a quick ripple, two heavy booming cracks a tenth of a second apart, punchy, short metallic ring, close up
tank's twin cannons fire one after the other, two loud heavy gunshots a split second apart, deep punchy boom with a hard crack, steel clank, short tail, close up
two sharp tank gun shots in rapid succession, deep punchy blasts with a crack on top, mechanical recoil thunk, brief rumble, close up
huge anchor artillery cannon fires one round: a sharp ear-splitting crack and an enormous deep boom that rolls away like distant thunder across a valley
massive long-range artillery gun firing, colossal concussive thump and blast, the report rolling off into the distance like thunder
single shot from a giant sci-fi shock cannon on a anchored tank, a hard metallic crack and a deep booming blast, then a long thundering rumble fading away
heavy artillery shell bursts on impact: a massive crunching explosion, dirt and debris raining down, deep rumbling tail
large high-explosive shell hits the ground and detonates, violent deep blast, shrapnel and rocks scattering, short rumble
incoming artillery round explodes, loud heavy thud of a shell burst, earth thrown up, crackle of debris falling back

heavy armored tank deploys into anchored mode over two seconds: hydraulic pistons pump and hiss, huge steel legs swing out and thud into the ground, the big cannon ratchets up, ending with a loud heavy locking clank
sci-fi Longbow transforms: servo whine and hydraulic hiss, heavy metal stabilisers stomp down, gears grind, a long barrel extends and clamps lock with loud clunks
massive war machine anchoring itself: deep hydraulic groan, heavy steel feet stomping down one after another, gears ratcheting, a cannon barrel sliding out, final heavy metal lock clank
heavy armored tank packs up from anchored mode: locking clamps release with a clank, hydraulics whine and hiss, steel legs retract with heavy clunks, a final latch
sci-fi Longbow folds back into tank mode: big cannon lowers with a servo whine, hydraulic hiss, stabiliser legs lift and fold in with heavy metal thunks
massive war machine retracting from anchored mode: heavy clamps unlatch with a clank, deep hydraulic groan and hiss, steel legs fold in with heavy metal thunks, a final latch
